create_Shards: create Shard dataclass instances to hold tensor data and associated shard metadata for distributed sharding
create_Shard_from_tensor: create a Shard from a local torch.Tensor, shard offsets list, and rank using from_tensor_and_offsets
test_Shard_validation: test Shard construction validates tensor size matches metadata shard_sizes and device matches placement
build_sharded_tensor_pipeline: build a distributed tensor sharding pipeline using Shard containers with offsets and rank-based placement
review_Shard_metadata: review Shard class that validates tensor dimensions and device placement against ShardMetadata
